select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.CCY ccy, CONCAT(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(T2.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d'),' - '), DATE_FORMAT(T2.MDATE2,'%Y-%m-%d')) as dueDate, T2.MDATE mdateAdd, T2.MDATE2 mdate2Add, T2.term_type termType, T1.ENTRUST_AMT/10000 entrustAmt, T2.busi_ps busiPs, T2.mature_yield*100 matureYield, T2.deal_mode dealMode, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T3.TRADER trader, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T1.REMARK remark from ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T3 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T3.ENTRUST_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
